scope: Analytic identity of implemented synthetic combat equations; not an empirical estimate.

combat_identity.experience_multiplier: V(E)=0.75+0.50E when state regeneration is enabled
combat_identity.capability_scaling: C proportional to N^0.72 * V(E), holding other factors fixed
combat_identity.exchange_ratio_scaling: ER proportional to q^0.90 for an own-side experience multiplier ratio q

replacement_identity: Adding trained but inexperienced replacements at E=0.10 dilutes formation experience by personnel-weighted averaging; survivors retain accumulated experience.
hypothesis: Veterancy creates positive survival hysteresis: experienced formations lose a smaller fraction per comparable contact, preserve more veteran stock, and require fewer inexperienced replacements, while high-turnover formations can enter a dilution spiral.
guard: Synthetic mechanism identity only. Effects assume no max-loss cap binds and all non-experience combat factors are held fixed.
